design.name: 雷泽雷神
design.brief: The Thunder God of Thunder Marsh (雷泽雷神) from the Shan Hai Jing: 'in Thunder Marsh there is a thunder god with a dragon's body and a human head; when it drums on its belly there is thunder'. A colossal Chinese serpentine dragon body (NOT a Western dragon), slate-blue and pale-jade scales in big carved plates, rising in several loops with two small clawed forelegs; the raised head and upper body stand about 10 m tall. The head is an enormous calm, stern, mask-like divine face (like a giant carved ritual mask, not a realistic person): long earlobes, braided whisker-beard, a crown of jagged thunder spikes. Its huge round pale belly is stretched like a drum skin painted with thunder spirals, beaten by its clawed hands; the drum centre glows magenta-violet (weak spot). Majestic and eerie.
design.role: 4-4 神山海子 · 章节终局
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the earlier rosters (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast, huodou sighthound): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Lightning is painted as OPAQUE glowing magenta-violet zig-zag veins and solid sculpted spark shapes on the body (never transparent bolts, particles, smoke or glow halos); fur, hair and feathers as a few large carved clumps.
design.note: 2026-10-23 进 Tripo：按「学烛阴」只建头、上身和双爪（四视图从出水线截平），长龙身在引擎里程序化（沿样条生成鳞片带）；双臂按玩法加长（龙爪拍击要够到 20 m 外），神面、腹鼓各一个可发光的材质槽（发光壳）
design.turnaround_lead: Upper-body model for the boss (the long serpent body is built separately and is NOT drawn):
design.turnaround_pose: the scaled dragon upper body rising straight up and cut FLAT and horizontal at the bottom edge (the water line: no coils, no tail, no water, no splash), about 10 m from the cut to the top of the crown, upright and symmetric; the huge round pale DRUM BELLY facing forward, its drum skin painted with thunder spirals and the drum centre a flat painted magenta-violet patch; the big calm stern mask-like divine face facing straight ahead with the mouth closed, long earlobes, the braided whisker-beard hanging straight down and ending ABOVE the drum belly (it never covers the drum); the crown of jagged thunder spikes as solid carved bronze and slate-blue shapes (not glowing); a ridge of slate-blue back plates down the spine; two LONG powerful scaled dragon ARMS (each arm almost as long as the upper body is tall) held out sideways and down in a relaxed A-pose with a wide gap of air between the arms and the body, bronze bands on the forearms, big open dragon claws with the palms facing down; MODELLING BASE STATE WITH EFFECTS SEPARATED: nothing glows and nothing emits light anywhere: no bloom, no halo, no light spill on the surrounding feathers or scales, no sparks, no electric arcs, and no crystal-like or spark-shaped spikes sticking out of the body (all of those are added later as game effects); every lightning vein is only a thin FLAT painted magenta line on the surface, like a tattoo, with crisp edges and the same matte lighting as the rest of the body; the eyes are flat painted colour
design.turnaround_digits: each dragon claw with four separate long curved talons clearly visible; exactly two arms; the whole crown, both claws and the flat bottom cut fully inside the frame.
